get_executor: create a submitit executor for local, slurm, or debug execution modes with configurable timeout and parallelism
map_array_and_wait: submit a function across a job array on slurm and wait for all jobs to complete
debug_executor: run a function sequentially in debug mode with automatic post-mortem debugging on exceptions
custom_map_array: execute a function across multiple local jobs with configurable task parallelism using submitit
SubmititRetryOnTimeout: wrap a callable in a submitit checkpointable class to enable retry on timeout
